renderer: deterministic p5.js Canvas 2D raster cure plate
memoryRule: a bounded dwell keeps the held well quiet while a remote zone seals, another fractures, and a third bleeds in the raster plate; four cures compound
interactionRule: pointer or touch presses and holds one material well until the bounded time window, then releases; short, overlong, and missed visits refuse; Enter, Space, and the cure control use a deterministic dwell; Delete lifts latest; Escape or R releases
representationRupture: continuous WEBGL relief membrane, Canvas fragment archive, and SVG wound field -> one flat p5.js Canvas 2D raster cure plate
compositionRupture: oblique surface, suspended fragments, and contour enclosure -> a single irregular pigment plate with a dry edge, central pressure seam, and remote phase zones
encounterRupture: separated visit, upward lift, and closed loop -> timed stillness: the visitor must sustain pressure without drawing a path
temporalRupture: remote backface relay, settling absence, and wound memory -> bounded dwell threshold with short/overlong refusal and phase memory
mediumRupture: p5.js WEBGL relief geometry, p5.js Canvas 2D fragments, and inline SVG topology -> p5.js 1.11.3 Canvas 2D raster cells with material fields
changedRule: A bounded dwell is the only accepted material input. The held well remains geometry-neutral; an accepted dwell changes three remote zones through actual raster mass, dryness, fracture, and bleed fields.
visibleConsequence: The blind view is one flat irregular pigment plate. A valid dwell produces a remote seal, fracture, and bleed away from the held well; four cures persist and can be lifted exactly.
falsifier: Delete if a passing touch changes the plate, if short or overlong dwell commits, if the held well answers itself, if remote roles are only colour/readout, if the blind plate reads as generic terrain or a heatmap, or if later cures reset.
deletionCondition: Delete v042 if caption-free viewing reads as a generic heatmap, terrain, pixel field, or decorative texture, or if duration does not materially change the raster plate's production.
promotion: candidate / held pending local and production browser matrices, independent caption-free perceptual review, and provider revision linkage
